title: Adherence to topical steroids in patients with CRSwNP Under Ongoing biologic therapy
summary: This study examines how consistently patients with chronic rhinosinusitis with nasal polyps (CRSwNP) use their prescribed corticosteroid nasal spray (e.g., mometasone) while undergoing biologic therapy. Many patients may not apply the spray regularly because their symptoms improve with biologics. The study measures actual nasal spray usage, compares it with patient-reported data, and investigates factors influencing adherence. The goal is to optimize treatment and ensure better integration of topical steroids into patient care.

interventions.name: cohort of 40 adult CRSwNP patients undergoing biologic therapy (therapy initiated at least 6 months ago)

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Severe chronic rhinosinusitis with nasal polyps (CRSwNP) according to EPOS/EUFOREA criteria
Ongoing biologic therapy (at least 6 months) according to German regulatory approval
Written informed consent for study participation
Exclusion criteria:
Lack of consent for participation
